Testing and Troubleshooting Perform point-to-point verification and functional testing. Troubleshoot meter communication, breaker status, trip indication, and data update issues. Ability to read electrical SLDs, wiring diagrams, and communication architecture drawings. Knowledge of electrical testing instruments and troubleshooting methods. Working knowledge of Windows servers, IP networking, and SQL Server is an advantage. 4. Educational Qualification Diploma or BE/B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Experience in electrical automation, smart metering, or power monitoring commissioning is preferred. 5. Key Competencies Site commissioning and troubleshooting skills. Strong documentation and problem-solving skills. 6. Performance Expectations Complete commissioning within the agreed project schedule. Ensure reliable communication and accurate data acquisition from all configured devices. Minimize repeat site visits through effective troubleshooting. Complete testing documentation and customer handover on time. Role & responsibilities Preferred candidate profile 0-3 Yrs Installation, Automation, Troubleshooting, PLC, PLC panel
